description:
Get trading hours for one or more market types.

Returns nested markdown — one block per market product Schwab knows
about within the requested categories:

  **<Product Name>** — OPEN | CLOSED
    Pre Market:  YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM — YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM
    Regular Market: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM — YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM
    Post Market: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM — YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

Sessions are emitted only when Schwab reports hours for them — a closed
market on a weekend or holiday will have no session lines under it.

date.description:
ISO date to check (e.g. "2026-03-15"). Defaults to today when
empty. The response is for a single trading day — pass each date
explicitly if you need a multi-day forecast.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

markets.description:
Comma-separated market types. Schwab supports "equity",
"option", "bond", "future", "forex". Unknown types are silently
dropped by Schwab.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

name: schwab_get_market_hours
title: Market hours
